text: Hello, really sorry to message so late, I know you must be busy and this is probly nothing. I'm a foster carer and I've had a little girl with me for a few weeks now, she's 4 months old. Tonight she just wont settle to sleep at all, every time I put her down she's back up again. I took her temprature and it was 38.3°C, I did it twice to be sure. Apart from that she seems fine honestly, she's wide awake and alert, looking around at everything and doing her little babbling noises at me, not sleepy or floppy or anything like that. I think I'm maybe just being over cautious because she's not my own and I feel responsable, and I don't want to get it wrong. I wasnt sure if I should just keep an eye on her or if a temperature like that at her age means she needs to be seen. Sorry again for bothering you with this, I just didnt know who else to ask at this time of night.
